{{Quote|The latest Journal of Xenomedicine reports that Wookiees live for centuries&mdash;and mate for life! How can they do that? It's unnatural.|Doc|<ref name="Wookiee" />}}
The '''Journal of Xenomedicine''' was a medical journal that was regularly released during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Knocks" /> Specializing in reporting on major achievements and influential figures<ref name="Healing">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Doc|Healing a Hutt}}</ref> in the field of [[xenomedicine]], the study of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] medicine and biology, the Journal once released a report on the lengthy lifespans and mating habits of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Wookiee" /> The [[xenopathologist]] and combat medic [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]], better known as Doc, contacted the Journal after he successfully cured the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Suudaa Nem'ro]] of a [[Suudaa Nem'ro's disease|unique disease]],<ref name="Healing" /> but the Journal was unable to examine the Hutt before<ref name="So Near">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Doc|So Near, Yet So Far}}</ref> the [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Skadge]]<ref name="Slugfest">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Skadge|Slugfest}}</ref> [[Death/Legends|killed]] Nem'ro.<ref name="So Near" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Journal of Xenomedicine is mentioned frequently throughout the series of conversation with Doc, a companion character for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Wookiee" /><ref name="Knocks">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Doc|Opportunity Knocks}}</ref><ref name="Healing" /><ref name="So Near" /> The culmination of the conversations about Nem'ro is a tie-in with the Bounty Hunter class, as that class' companion Skadge leaves the player to hunt down the Hutt who betrayed him in the conversation "Slugfest."<ref name="Slugfest" />
